text_block_list.text: We've won so many races together, but thinking about what lies ahead, there's still plenty of work to be done.

"While I was taking care of all that work,
drowsiness eventually overtook me—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
Regarding our future schedule—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What's this? I thought you were working, but you're asleep...
Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, we haven't had a single moment to catch our breath until now.
I suppose it's only natural...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Looking back, the only victory party we had was at Christmas... Should I treat her to something more?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (—Ah, come to think of it...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I should have that ticket...
Could it be... that I'm supposed to use that?)

—The next day.
While I was working, Air Groove walked in
with a stiffer expression than usual.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...A hot spring trip ticket.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you still have the hot springs ticket
I entrusted to you back then?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Keep hold of it for now.
I shall make an appropriate judgment later.

"Come to think of it, there was something like that.
It should still be sitting in the drawer."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's the look of someone who remembered after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The time has come to use that.
The ones going are me and... you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We depart the day after tomorrow. Adjust your work schedule and pack your bags by then. ...That is all.

Without giving me a chance to reply,
Air Groove walked away...

Without quite grasping the situation,
I ended up going on a hot springs trip. And then—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That wasn't a bad bath.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Apparently, these hot springs are good for muscle aches and stiff shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How was it... for you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

Even after arriving at our destination,
Air Groove has kept a stiff expression the whole time.

She was the one who brought up taking a trip,
so what could be wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What about it?

The moment I pointed that out,
Air Groove's demeanor changed completely.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh— What ridiculous nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you're one to talk!
You're usually way noisier than this!
So why are you like this today—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...No... wait, is that wrong?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is merely because I am tense...
that it has spread to you as well...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... I had no intention
of letting things turn out like this...
choice_data_list: What do you mean, you didn't mean to?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...How to use the travel voucher.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We have run through three years of joys and hardships together, haven't we? Never looking away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps out of habit,
you are still overworking yourself even now."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "So I had hoped this trip would serve as at least some small reward for your hard work."

I see...
So she was just being considerate in her own way.
Then, if there's anything else left to clear up—
choice_data_list: Then why are you so tense?
Then why are you so tense?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: T-That's—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I wasn't quite sure how close to get...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, it is nothing of great importance, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...*Sigh*, making any more excuses
would just be pathetic, wouldn't it...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: At the academy, my role is to guide the students as the "Empress." I never let my guard down in front of others.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, there is no need to be that way right here, right now.
Just as that thought crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How I should be, and how
I should interact with you... I've lost sight of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... To think I'd end up having to talk about
something so pathetic...!

So by disciplining yourself so strictly as the "Empress,"
you've forgotten how to simply be your true self?
However—if that's the case, the solution is simple.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh—?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?! As someone being entertained,
that's my line!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Get plenty of nutrition, soak thoroughly in a hot bath,
and get a full night's sleep... Honestly!!

I ate my meal while getting scolded for some reason,
and then got plenty of rest.
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond between Air Groove and myself...
